description: Chuck trains to become a genuine agent while new capabilities, secrets and shifting loyalties complicate his relationship with Sarah and the team's fight against the Ring.

s03e01.description: Chuck’s upgraded Intersect gives him remarkable new skills but unstable performance during spy training, while his choice to pursue the agent life drives Sarah away and Morgan returns home.

s03e02.description: Carina returns for a mission involving a stolen weapon and a marriage of convenience, forcing Chuck and Sarah to work through the emotional damage left by Prague.

s03e03.description: An assassination attempt against Premier Goya of Costa Gravas pulls Devon into the spy world and leaves Chuck scrambling to protect both his brother-in-law and the visiting leader.

s03e04.description: The Ring mistakes Devon for a legendary spy, forcing Chuck to become his handler and mount a rescue while new operative Daniel Shaw takes command of the team.

s03e05.description: Chuck is sent on his first solo mission to Paris and encounters Hannah and dangerous smuggler Hugo Panzer, testing whether he can function as an agent without Sarah or Casey beside him.

s03e06.description: Chuck handles his first intelligence asset, brilliant engineer Manoosh Depak, and discovers how difficult it is to manipulate someone who trusts him when the Ring starts closing in.

s03e07.description: Chuck and Hannah grow closer while Sarah is paired with Shaw on a mission, and Ellie and Morgan begin investigating the increasingly suspicious secrecy surrounding Chuck.

s03e08.description: Chuck impersonates assassin Rafe Gruber to infiltrate a Ring operation, while Hannah learns that Chuck has been lying to her and his attempt at a normal relationship collapses.

s03e09.description: The Intersect stops responding just as Ring agents infiltrate Castle, leaving Chuck without his usual advantage and forcing Morgan to learn the truth about his best friend’s spy life.

s03e10.description: Casey appears to betray the country under orders from former commander James Keller, but Chuck and Sarah uncover the coercion behind his actions and a secret connection to Alex.

s03e11.description: Chuck’s final spy exam requires him to capture Ring operative Perry and apparently prove he can kill on command, putting his moral limits directly at odds with becoming a full agent.

s03e12.description: Chuck decides he still wants a future with Sarah and races to stop her from leaving with Shaw, while Casey, Morgan and Devon quietly help him pursue both the mission and the relationship.

s03e13.description: Shaw learns that Sarah killed his wife during her red test and takes her to a Ring facility, forcing Chuck into a rescue that ends with him making the lethal choice he had resisted.

s03e14.description: Chuck and Sarah finally run away together on a train through Europe, only to cross paths with Basque separatist spies while Casey and Morgan are sent to bring them home.

s03e15.description: Chuck and Sarah work with a veteran married CIA couple whose apparently ideal partnership becomes a cautionary tale, while Morgan begins his own awkward transition into field work.

s03e16.description: Chuck’s vivid dreams appear to predict an assassination attempt against a visiting president, raising fears that the Intersect is damaging his brain even as the clues prove useful.

s03e17.description: Stephen Bartowski returns and discovers the consequences of Intersect 2.0, while the Ring manipulates Ellie and the supposedly dead Shaw prepares his return.

s03e18.description: The Ring closes in on the Bartowski family, Stephen tries to protect Chuck from the Intersect’s deterioration and Casey struggles to keep Alex safe as long-hidden plans come together.

s03e19.description: Shaw and the Ring infiltrate the CIA itself, forcing Team Bartowski to expose its leadership while the Buy More is destroyed and Stephen’s hidden legacy points Chuck toward the mystery of his mother.
